name: Elias Goldstein
source:
Likes: Reading. He has a a sweet tooth.
Dislikes: Frivolous, irresponsible people and hates rumors.
Hobby: Spending time reading and carrying out research on magic.
Skill: Memorizing Incantations

"I don't think I need a buddy. Not you. Not anyone."

Yukiya: Elias is my roommate.
He is smart, but a little uptight.
He has outstanding school grades and always stays on top.
His only problem is sometimes he can be a bit harsh.
People are afraid of him.
But how can you blame him? He's got a point.
He was born into the famous family, the Goldsteins.
He doesn't talk about his family and I never ask. Maybe there's something he doesn't want us to know...

[Edited from official in-game description (Main Story)]
